privacy.title: Itangazo ryerekeye ubuzima bwite
privacy.draft: Inyandiko y'agateganyo itegereje kwemezwa n'Ushinzwe Amategeko n'Iyubahirizwa ryayo mu Rugaga.
privacy.body: Dukusanya amakuru bwite akenewe mu kwandika no guha impushya abakomisiyoneri n'ibigo by'ubukomisiyoneri bw'imitungo itimukanwa, no kubungabunga igitabo rusange. Dukusanya buri kintu gusa iyo icyiciro cyawe cyangwa ubwoko bw'ubusabe bwawe bubisaba. Amakuru yawe arinzwe (encrypted), agerwaho n'abakozi bayakeneye mu kazi gusa, kandi buri gihe amakuru y'ibanga arebwe birandikwa. Amakuru agaragara mu mategeko agenga igitabo ni yo yonyine atangazwa. Ushobora gusaba kopi y'amakuru yawe igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
privacy.metaDescription: Uko urubuga rukusanya, rurinda kandi rutangaza amakuru bwite.

g1.title: Imbibi z'abohereza abakiriya gusa (Ingingo ya 10)
g1.article10:
Ingingo ya 10 — Abahuza bohereza abakiriya mu by'imitungo itimukanwa

1. Uwohereza abakiriya ashobora gusa kumenyekanisha cyangwa kohereza abashobora kuba abakiriya ku mukora umwuga cyangwa ikigo bifite uruhushya.
2. Uwohereza abakiriya ntashobora kuganira ku masezerano, kwerekana cyangwa kwamamaza umutungo ku giti cye, kubika amafaranga y'abakiriya, cyangwa gushyira umukono cyangwa kubera umuhamya amasezerano ayo ari yo yose mu izina ry'uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose.
3. Uwohereza abakiriya akorera munsi y'igenzura rivugwa mu ruhushya rwe kandi agomba kumenyesha buri mukiriya uruhare rwe rwo kohereza abakiriya.
4. Igihembo cyose cyo kohereza abakiriya cyishyurwa gusa binyuze mu kigo kimugenzura kandi kigomba kwandikwa.

(Incamake y'igerageza — inyandiko y'amategeko yemejwe izayisimbura.)
g1.ack: Nasomye kandi nemera imbibi z'abohereza abakiriya gusa ziteganywa n'Ingingo ya 10.
